speaker: alice
text: Lets kick off green and gold, literally, because Queensland is once again leading the nation for rooftop solar. More households are clicking over to panels this spring, which means lower bills and a lighter footprint for the Sunshine State.

speaker: charlie
text: Its funny, we complain about the heat up here but then we go and turn it into free power, thats peak Queensland problem solving right there. Meanwhile out on the reef, citizen scientists diving the inshore sites are reporting some genuinely encouraging coral recovery.

speaker: alice
text: Yeah after some tough bleaching years its lovely to hear divers talking about colour coming back rather than coral graveyards. Small wins, but they add up, and its proof that when locals get involved the reef actually has a fighting chance.
